download.funFacts.0: Battly started as a personal tool and became a public launcher.
download.funFacts.1: OptiFine improves Minecraft performance and supports HD textures and shaders.
download.funFacts.2: Creepers appeared by accident while a pig was being created during Minecraft development.
download.funFacts.3: Fabric is often lighter and faster than other mod loaders.
download.funFacts.4: Battly lets you combine vanilla versions and mod loaders without changing your base installation.
